title: Genesis space shooter with a crimson nebula
input: Make me a Sega Genesis space shoot-'em-up with a red background instead of blue space.
caption: Forked the Genesis shooter example, recoloured the nebula palette, built the .md ROM and play-tested it: the clip is the emulator run with Up/Right and fire pressed on a script.

title: NES platformer on a navy sky
input: Make a small NES game I can move around with the D-pad, on a dark blue background.
caption: A real .nes ROM built with the cc65 toolchain; the play-test pressed A to start, then held Right and Left, and the picture changed with each input.
